import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Scanner {
        private final BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        public Scanner(InputStream in) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
            st = new StringTokenizer("");
        }

        public String next() {
            while (!st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    String line = br.readLine();
                    if (line == null) return null;
                    st = new StringTokenizer(line);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    static class Printer {
        private final BufferedWriter bw;

        public Printer(OutputStream out) {
            bw = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(out));
        }

        public void print(String s) throws IOException {
            bw.write(s);
        }

        public void println(String s) throws IOException {
            bw.write(s);
            bw.newLine();
        }

        public void flush() throws IOException {
            bw.flush();
        }
    }

    static class ModInt {
        private long v;
        private static int mod;
        private static boolean prime;

        public static void setMod(int m) {
            mod = m;
            prime = isPrime(m);
        }

        public static boolean isPrime(int n) {
            if (n <= 1) return false;
            if (n <= 3) return true;
            if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0) return false;
            for (int i = 5; i * i <= n; i += 6) {
                if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        public ModInt() {
            this.v = 0;
        }

        public ModInt(long v) {
            this.v = v % mod;
            if (this.v < 0) this.v += mod;
        }

        public static ModInt raw(int v) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt();
            res.v = v;
            return res;
        }

        public ModInt add(ModInt rhs) {
            long res = this.v + rhs.v;
            if (res >= mod) res -= mod;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt subtract(ModInt rhs) {
            long res = this.v - rhs.v;
            if (res < 0) res += mod;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt multiply(ModInt rhs) {
            long res = (this.v * rhs.v) % mod;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt pow(long n) {
            ModInt base = new ModInt(this.v);
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public ModInt inv() {
            if (prime) {
                return this.pow(mod - 2);
            } else {
                long[] eg = invGCD(this.v, mod);
                assert eg[0] == 1;
                return new ModInt(eg[1]);
            }
        }

        public long val() {
            return v;
        }

        private static long[] invGCD(long a, long b) {
            long s = b, t = a;
            long m0 = 0, m1 = 1;
            while (t != 0) {
                long u = s / t;
                s -= t * u;
                m0 -= m1 * u;
                long tmp = s;
                s = t;
                t = tmp;
                tmp = m0;
                m0 = m1;
                m1 = tmp;
            }
            if (m0 < 0) m0 += b / s;
            return new long[]{s, m0};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Printer pr = new Printer(System.out);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();
        ModInt.setMod(mod);

        ModInt[][] C = new ModInt[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(C[i], new ModInt(0));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = new ModInt(1);
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1].add(C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        ModInt[] g = new ModInt[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            g[i] = new ModInt(i).multiply(new ModInt(i + 1)).multiply(new ModInt(0.5));
        }

        class Pair {
            ModInt first, second;
            Pair(ModInt f, ModInt s) {
                this.first = f;
                this.second = s;
            }
        }

        Pair[] f = new Pair[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = new Pair(new ModInt(0), new ModInt(0));
        }
        f[0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0));

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                ModInt z = f[j].first.multiply(f[i - 1 - j].first).multiply(C[i - 1][j]);
                f[i].first = f[i].first.add(z.multiply(new ModInt(i + 1)));
                f[i].second = f[i].second.add(z.multiply(g[j].add(g[i - 1 - j])));
                ModInt term = (f[i - 1 - j].first.multiply(f[j].second).add(f[j].first.multiply(f[i - 1 - j].second)))
                        .multiply(C[i - 1][j]).multiply(new ModInt(i + 1));
                f[i].second = f[i].second.add(term);
            }
        }

        // Debug output (can be omitted)
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            // System.err.println(i + " " + f[i].first.val() + " " + f[i].second.val() + " " + g[i].val());
        }

        Pair[][] dp = new Pair[n + 2][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new Pair(new ModInt(0), new ModInt(0));
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0));

        for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
            for (int r = l + 1; r <= n + 1; r++) {
                int di = r - l - 1;
                for (int i = 0; i + di <= m; i++) {
                    Pair prev = dp[l][i];
                    Pair currF = f[di];
                    ModInt z = prev.first.multiply(currF.first);
                    dp[r][i + di].first = dp[r][i + di].first.add(z.multiply(C[i + di][di]));
                    Pair prevSecond = dp[l][i];
                    ModInt secondPart = (prevSecond.second.multiply(currF.first).add(prevFirst.second.multiply(currF.second)))
                            .multiply(C[i + di][di]);
                    dp[r][i + di].second = dp[r][i + di].second.add(secondPart);
                }
            }
        }

        // Final answer
        pr.println(Long.toString(dp[n + 1][m].second.val()));
        pr.flush();
    }
}
